Assessment.hubMetaTitle: Free AI, Cybersecurity & Cloud Maturity Assessments | Huntay AzerTürk
Assessment.hubMetaDescription: How ready is your company for AI, cyberattacks and growth? Free 3-minute assessments show your score and first 3 steps instantly. No sign-up.
Assessment.hubIntro: How ready is your company for AI, cyberattacks and growth? Each assessment takes about 3 minutes and ends with a 0–100 score, a breakdown by area and the 3 steps to take first.
Assessment.privacy: No name, email or phone needed. Your answers are scored in your browser and not stored on any server.
Assessment.capped: Your level is capped at {level} because of this critical answer:
Assessment.diy: You can do some of these steps with your own team; if you want help deciding where to start, or doing it together, see the options below.
Assessment.ctaPackageText: The best starting point for this result: {name}. Fixed scope and price, ending in a prioritized roadmap. If you'd rather talk first, book a 30-minute call; your score is added to the booking note.
Assessment.ctaCallText: In a 30-minute call we'll go through your result, the biggest bottleneck and the right first step. Your score is added to the booking note.
Assessment.disclaimer: This is a quick self-assessment, not an audit, certification or legal opinion. The questions are original and inspired by: {frameworks}. Thresholds are refined over time with real answers.
Assessment.serviceCta: Free assessment: see your level in 3 minutes

AiPath.title: AI transformation starts in customer service
AiPath.subtitle: It's where results show fastest and the data is already in your hands. With the trust we earn there, we move on to other departments.
AiPath.pain1: Do your dealers and customers keep asking the same fault and how-to questions, tying your engineers up on the phone?
AiPath.pain2: Are manuals, service bulletins and price lists lost in folders, with only a few people knowing the right answer?
AiPath.pain3: Are quote and order questions wearing out your sales team, and nobody can say exactly where line stops and scrap come from?
AiPath.step1Text: A short assessment call, then a report in 5 business days ranking the processes with the highest return.
AiPath.step2Text: An assistant that answers support and service questions from your own manuals; live in 3 weeks without changing your existing software.
AiPath.step3Text: Once the pilot works, a turnkey rollout; then the same approach in production, quality, sales and marketing.
AiPath.proof: In different projects, AI-assisted systems cut support ticket resolution time by 40–70%.
